messages:
jess: Quick heads-up — production eu embeddings are seeing sporadic 503s after the serializer change in #model-serving. Root cause looks like a nil in aligner v2 when sequence_len==0. Need an expedited hotfix deploy (patch build + pin) during the night window. Can we get approval to pin and skip the full canary?
mark: how widespread? metrics?
jess: ~3–5% of requests to eu1 embeddings endpoint over last 20m, spike after 02:14 UTC. CPU and p95 unchanged, error rate is request-level 503s. Linking logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/eg/xyz (internal)
priya: if it's sequence_len==0 we can add a guard and rebuild a small patch. CI should be green in ~12m. prefer staged canary but if error rate keeps climbing, skip canary and pin to mitigate.
luca: oncall: +1 for expedited, but need rollback criteria and a pinned fallback model (older serializer). If we skip canary, limit to dedicated eu pool 10% traffic first then increase.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-331. Pager duty notified.
deploy-bot: Patch build started: builder-42. Tests: unit 139/139, integration queued. ETA ~10m.
jess: rollback plan: revert config to serializer:v1 (tag v1.21.3) and route traffic to eu-pool-old; if errors >1% after deploy, rollback immediately. Also will keep KV cache warmers disabled until 30m post-deploy.
mark: can you paste the deploy command and runbook steps?
jess: deploy command:
```
./deploy --env=prod --region=eu1 --service=embeddings --image=serializer:v2-hotfix-17698 --pin=true --canary=0
```
runbook steps: 1) apply image to eu1 dedicated nodes 2) monitor errors and p50/p95 3) if error>1% rollback to v1.21.3 4) postmortem if rollback.
priya: CI green on unit/integration. e2e still running. I ran a quick local with len=0 sequences and guard fixes nil. looks good.
oncall-kate: I'm standing by. +1 for skip canary if we limit to eu dedicated pool and keep circuit-breaker at 50r/s.
luca: Ops: add temp routing rule and automute alerts for spike so we don't cascade.
deploy-bot: Build complete, image pushed: registry.redwood/serializer:v2-hotfix-17698. Canary jobs skipped by request flag.
mark: +1. approve expedited deploy. please add the change window to release notes and notify infra.
jess: executing now. will post checkpoints.
ops-bot: Deploy started by jess at 1769812400.
jess: Checkpoint: rollout to eu dedicated pool started, 10% traffic. no increase in 503s at 5m. proceeding to 50%.
priya: monitoring shows error down to 0.2% on canary hosts. good signal.
luca: holding at 50% for 10m, then full pin if stable. watch DB connections.
jess: 50% -> 100% traffic applied. finalizing pin.
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: serializer:v2-hotfix-17698 pinned to eu1 at 1769812600.
oncall-kate: Verified: error rate back to baseline, closing incident. nice work. :tada:
mark: Add a brief note to release notes: emergency serializer fix, pinned in eu1, rollback criteria documented.
jess: will add post-deploy summary to release notes and start a short RCA doc tomorrow. thanks all for quick approvals. :thumbsup:
